'''Luca''' was a young [[Da'shain Aiel]] after the [[Breaking]].  

==Appearance==
His shoulders were half again as wide as anyone else’s and he liked to play tricks.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Luca|comp}}  

==History==
He helped [[Lewin]], [[Alijha]], [[Gearan]], and [[Charlin]] free [[Maigran]] and [[Colline]] from bandits. When they killed the bandits, they were disowned by their families for using violence; a violation of the core beliefs of the [[Da'shain Aiel]].{{ref/book|4|25}}

==Errata==
He is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but since he is part of the group that breaks the [[First Covenant]], he should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref||comp}}
